source: Recorded on the maintainer's Windows machine (real-CLI lane, 17 §5.5) through scripts/fixtures/record.mjs (runRecord with a scratch recording adapter, not registered) and scrub.mjs, against the person's own user-installed @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp 1.13.1 (Apache-2.0, pnpm global install; never bundled or shipped by DwarfAI) started as node <adapter entry> with shell: false, with the childEnv allowlist plus CODEX_PATH = the person's own codex-cli 0.153.4 (native codex.exe, C-18; never the adapter's bundled @openai/codex 0.156.1) and INITIAL_AGENT_MODE=read-only. The adapter ran outside CodexAcpDriver: on Windows codex-acp 1.13.1 starts CODEX_PATH with spawn(`"<path>" app-server`, { shell: true }) (dist/index.js, startCodexConnection), which 18 C-17 forbids for DwarfAI, so the driver still refuses Windows; the recording only captures the ACP traffic. The recorder framed what CodexAcpDriver sends (initialize with no client capability, session/new and session/load {cwd, mcpServers: []}, session/prompt, session/cancel, session/close; permission requests answered allow_once, the first reject_once, or cancelled), with the recorded prompts of the -sent streams. Codex read the person's own config (model, MCP servers, skills): the skills listed in available_commands_update are numbered placeholders. In c-06 the command's output (the maintainer's PowerShell profile messages, printed by every command Codex runs) was replaced by <PROFILE-OUTPUT> in the raw capture before scrubbing, with the timing bytes adjusted. macOS and Linux recordings are pending (maintainer machines). Cases no recording covers stay in ../0.157.x-synthetic/.

capabilities.modes: read-only (Ask for approval: on-request, approvalsReviewer user, workspace-write sandbox), agent (Approve for me: approvalsReviewer auto_review, the adapter's default), agent-full-access (approvalPolicy never); 1.13.1 has no workspace-write mode id, an unknown INITIAL_AGENT_MODE falls back to agent, and session/set_mode with an unknown id is refused -32602
capabilities.denyOption: cancel (reject_once): Codex fails the command and ends the turn with stopReason cancelled
capabilities.permissionRequestTitle: Run command (the command is in rawInput.command and in the preceding tool_call title)
capabilities.promptUsage: per turn; inputTokens exclude cachedReadTokens, outputTokens include thoughtTokens
capabilities.windows: recorded on Windows (adapter run outside the driver); the driver still refuses Windows (C-17)
